newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bill prices rise further.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bill prices rise further.

text.p: Russian GKO Treasury bill prices continued to firm on Friday, but the rate of growth slowed with longer dates rising 0.3 points as yields fell towards 30 percent, dealers said.
* average yield fell to 32.2 percent from 34.2 percent
* turnover rose to 6.94 trillion roubles from 5.69 trillion

"Thanks to buying by non-residents, prices went up in the first half of the day, but then most investors decided to wait until Monday to buy, hoping for better prices, and started to take profits," said dealer Andrei Koshchy of Bank MFK.
Other dealers said paper could test the 30 percent barrier on Monday but doubted it would slip below that level.
